purpose: Split settings status into Saved vs Verified with cause-class validation diagnostics and a keyless trial preview to fix verify-but-not-persist confusion.
riskRationale: All eight iteration-1 findings are verified fixed in the current tree, credential handling stays blind, escaping is complete, and phpcs is clean with phpunit 53/53 passing; no extra HTTP or credential surface was added.

text: The PR delivers what it claims: a shared cached probe backing isConfigured/diagnose with one TTL, Saved-vs-Verified UI with cause diagnostics and a save-reverted hint, plus a keyless dry-run preview. Version sync is restored at 0.1.5 everywhere, the partial-SDK guard is complete, fail-open guards are consistent, and DiagnosticsTest plus extended bust-hook tests cover the new paths.

reasoning: All four review subagents failed to dispatch (free-tier restriction: OpenCode free tier can only be used from within OpenCode), so a direct fallback review was performed: all previously reported issues are verified fixed by reading the current files, and phpunit (53 tests) plus phpcs pass with no new defect found.

message: Bust closures take zero parameters and only delete plugin-owned transients plus set a per-catalog timestamp marker, preserving the credential-blind hard rule (no connectors_ai_* reads/writes).

Single shared probe() backs isConfigured() and diagnose() with one TTL for verdict+cause, so diagnostics add zero extra HTTP as claimed; SDK entry points are probed defensively with fail-open to network-failure.
HTTP 403 is only mapped to bad-key when the error body is auth-shaped, otherwise unknown, so geo-blocks or policy refusals do not misdirect users into re-entering a valid key.
validCauses() now guards ProviderAvailabilityInterface plus both SDK traits before touching the availability class, closing the partial-SDK uncatchable-fatal surface cited in iteration 1.
diagnosisFor() defaults to unknown and never forces a live-configured verdict into ok, preserving throttled/valid-no-credits precision while keeping the registry boolean.

All user-facing output is escaped (esc_html/wp_kses_post) including the filterable dry-run message, and the non-affiliation disclaimer and version sync (0.1.5 header, const, Stable tag, Changelog, Upgrade Notice) are intact.
